description: Consolidated JSON schemas for the MoMo SMS data processing system. Contains individual entity representations, a complete nested transaction example, and the SQL-to-JSON mapping documentation.

user._comment: Maps to 'user' table. Each user represents a MoMo account holder (STANDARD, MERCHANT, or AGENT).
user.name: Orla ISHIMWE

transaction._comment: Maps to 'transaction' table. Core event record with reference_id from SMS.
transaction.raw_sms_text: You have transferred 5,000 RWF to Benito KABALI (+250788123456). Your new balance is 14,900 RWF. TxnID: TXN-20240320-00482.

transaction_category._comment: Maps to 'transaction_category' table. Lookup for transaction types.
transaction_category.name: P2P Transfer

user_transaction._comment: Maps to 'user_transactions' junction table. Links users to transactions with a role (SENDER/RECEIVER).

system_log._comment: Maps to 'system_logs' table. Application activity log, optionally linked to a transaction.

complete_transaction._comment: Complete transaction API response — all related entities nested for a single API call. Maps to: Transaction JOIN user_transactions JOIN user JOIN transaction_category LEFT JOIN system_logs.

transaction.raw_sms_text: You have transferred 5000 RWF to Benito KABALI (+250788123456). Your new balance is 14,900   RWF. TxnID: TXN-20240320-00482.

sql_to_json_mapping.description: Documents how each SQL table column maps to its JSON key counterpart, including type conversions and nesting strategies used in API responses.

general_conventions.datetime_format: ISO 8601 (e.g. 2024-03-20T14:22:10Z) — DATETIME columns always serialized to UTC ISO strings
general_conventions.foreign_keys: FK columns (e.g. category_id, user_id) are replaced by their resolved nested objects in API responses; the raw integer FK is omitted
general_conventions.enums: ENUM columns serialize as uppercase strings matching the SQL ENUM member exactly
general_conventions.omitted_fields: Redundant FK integers that are implicit from nesting context (e.g. transaction_id inside system_logs) are omitted to keep responses clean
